// =========================================================================
// web/views/helpers-handlebars.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Handlebars is intentionally a template language SANS LOGIQUE: no
// expressions JavaScript in views—only {{variables}} and
// {{#if}} / {{#each}} blocks... When a view needs a little more, it is
// a "helper" is provided: a TypeScript function that can be called from the view.
//
// The application only needs four helpers:
//    {{t 'CLE'}                  } translation (equivalent to the `| translate` pipe)
//    {{t 'CLE' name=personne.nom }} translation with parameter(s)
//    {{#if (eq a b)}             } equality comparison
//    {{#if (or a b)}             } true if at least one of the arguments is true
//    {{active path '/doctors'}}   "active" if the current page is under this path
// =========================================================================

import { HelperOptions } from 'handlebars';
import { Langue, LANGUE_PAR_DEFAUT, estUneLangue, traduire } from '../i18n';

// The 'hbs' module has no type declarations: here we describe the few
// that we use
interface Hbs {
  registerHelper(nom: string, fonction: (...args: any[]) => unknown): void;
}

export function enregistrerHelpers(hbs: Hbs): void {
   // The last argument received by a helper is always the [options] object from
   // Handlebars: options.hash contains the named parameters (name=...), and
   // options.data.root the COMPLET template for the page —and therefore also res.locals.lang,
   // the selected language (see contexte-vue.ts), even within a {{#each}}.
  hbs.registerHelper('t', (cle: unknown, options: HelperOptions) => {
    const lang = options.data?.root?.lang;
    const langue: Langue = estUneLangue(lang) ? lang : LANGUE_PAR_DEFAUT;
     // the returned text is then escaped by Handlebars ({{ }} and not {{{ }}}):
     // A name entered by the user cannot therefore inject HTML
    return typeof cle === 'string' ? traduire(langue, cle, options.hash) : '';
  });

  hbs.registerHelper('eq', (a: unknown, b: unknown) => a === b);

   // ...args: all arguments; the last one is the object [options] from
   // Handlebars (see above), which is discarded before testing the others
  hbs.registerHelper('ou', (...args: unknown[]) => args.slice(0, -1).some(Boolean));

  hbs.registerHelper('actif', (chemin: unknown, prefixe: unknown) =>
    typeof chemin === 'string' && typeof prefixe === 'string' && chemin.startsWith(prefixe) ? 'active' : '',
  );
}
  • lines 31–37: the translation helper (see Example 22);
  • line 39: the equality check (see Example 16);
  • line 43: true if any of the arguments is true. [...args] receives all the arguments; the last one is the [options] object from [Handlebars], which is discarded;
  • lines 45–47: the [active] class of the current menu (see Example 16).

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// web/models/formulaire-personne.dto.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The fields in the "person" forms and their constraints. Three
// forms share the same identity fields (title, first name, last name):
//
//    ChampsPersonneDt              o title, first name, last name
//     ├─ FormulairePersonneD      to + login / password FACULTATIFS, version
//                                     │ (ADMIN adds or modifies a doctor/client)
//     ├─ FormulaireInscriptionD   to + login / password / confirmation OBLIGATOIRES
//                                     │ (a patient creates an account)
//     └─ FormulaireMonCompteD     to + username, optional new password,
//                                      ACTUEL password required, version
//                                      (a patient modifies their account)
//
// Class inheritance also applies to class-validator decorators:
// A child class inherits the field constraints of its parent class.
//
// Error messages are translation strings (see i18n/*.json).
// @Transform(...) (class-transformer) cleans up the input AVANT
// validation: unnecessary spaces removed, optional fields left blank
// set to `undefined`, login converted to lowercase, version converted to a number
// (anything coming from a form HTML is a string).
//
// The "password = confirmation" check applies to DEUX fields: it
// is performed by the validator after each field is validated.
// =========================================================================

import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';
import { IsIn, IsInt, IsNotEmpty, IsOptional, Matches, MaxLength, MinLength } from 'class-validator';

export const TITRES = ['Mr', 'Mme', 'Melle'];

const nettoyer = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : value);
const videEnUndefined = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) =>
  typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '' ? value.trim() : undefined;
const loginNettoye = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) => videEnUndefined({ value })?.toLowerCase();
// A password is not “cleaned” (spaces may be included)
const motDePasseOuUndefined = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) =>
  typeof value === 'string' && value !== '' ? value : undefined;
const nombreOuUndefined = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) =>
  value === undefined || value === '' ? undefined : Number(value);

// Login: lowercase letters, numbers, period, hyphen, underscore—30 characters maximum
const FORMAT_LOGIN = /^[a-z0-9._-]{1,30}$/;
// minimum password length CHOISI entered by a patient
export const MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN = 6;

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ common base
export class ChampsPersonneDto {
  @IsIn(TITRES, { message: 'ERRORS.INVALID_TITLE' })
  titre: string;

   // maximum lengths = those of the columns SQL (VARCHAR(20))
  @Transform(nettoyer)
  @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'ERRORS.FIRSTNAME_REQUIRED' })
  @MaxLength(20, { message: 'ERRORS.FIRSTNAME_TOO_LONG' })
  prenom: string;

  @Transform(nettoyer)
  @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED' })
  @MaxLength(20, { message: 'ERRORS.LASTNAME_TOO_LONG' })
  nom: string;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ ADMIN
export class FormulairePersonneDto extends ChampsPersonneDto {
   // optional (see DonneesPersonne, metier.interface.ts)
  @Transform(loginNettoye)
  @IsOptional()
  @Matches(FORMAT_LOGIN, { message: 'ERRORS.INVALID_LOGIN' })
  login?: string;

   // optional; 72 characters maximum (if longer, bcrypt ignores the rest)
  @Transform(motDePasseOuUndefined)
  @IsOptional()
  @MaxLength(72, { message: 'ERRORS.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG' })
  password?: string;

   // hidden field in the edit form (optimistic lock)
  @Transform(nombreOuUndefined)
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt({ message: 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM' })
  version?: number;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ patient registration
export class FormulaireInscriptionDto extends ChampsPersonneDto {
  @Transform(loginNettoye)
  @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'ERRORS.LOGIN_REQUIRED' })
  @Matches(FORMAT_LOGIN, { message: 'ERRORS.INVALID_LOGIN' })
  login: string;

  @Transform(motDePasseOuUndefined)
  @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'ERRORS.PASSWORD_REQUIRED' })
  @MinLength(MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN, { message: 'ERRORS.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT' })
  @MaxLength(72, { message: 'ERRORS.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG' })
  password: string;

  @Transform(motDePasseOuUndefined)
  @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'ERRORS.CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED' })
  confirmation: string;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ "Manage My Account"
export class FormulaireMonCompteDto extends ChampsPersonneDto {
  @Transform(loginNettoye)
  @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'ERRORS.LOGIN_REQUIRED' })
  @Matches(FORMAT_LOGIN, { message: 'ERRORS.INVALID_LOGIN' })
  login: string;

   // optional: empty = password unchanged
  @Transform(motDePasseOuUndefined)
  @IsOptional()
  @MinLength(MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN, { message: 'ERRORS.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT' })
  @MaxLength(72, { message: 'ERRORS.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG' })
  password?: string;

  @Transform(motDePasseOuUndefined)
  @IsOptional()
  confirmation?: string;

   // the password ACTUEL, required for any account changes
  @Transform(motDePasseOuUndefined)
  @IsNotEmpty({ message: 'ERRORS.CURRENT_PASSWORD_REQUIRED' })
  motDePasseActuel: string;

  @Transform(nombreOuUndefined)
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt({ message: 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM' })
  version?: number;
}

Let’s comment on this code:

  • line 32: possible titles;
  • lines 34–42: the cleaning functions applied by [@Transform] before validation: removal of spaces, empty fields reduced to [undefined] (so that [@IsOptional] will accept them), login in lowercase, version converted to a number. A password is not sanitized: its spaces are part of it;
  • line 45: the format of a username, described by a regular expression;
  • lines 50–64: the identity fields, common to three forms. The maximum lengths are those of the SQL columns. The messages are translation keys;
  • lines 67–85: the ADMIN form (doctor or client): optional username and password, and the version for optimistic locking. [extends]: the class inherits the fields and decorators from its parent. A password must be 72 characters or fewer; bcrypt ignores any characters beyond that limit;
  • lines 88–103: a patient creates an account: username and password required, at least six characters, and confirmation;
  • lines 106–132: a patient modifying their account: new password optional, current password required.

// =========================================================================
// web/helpers/formulaire.helper.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Validation of a form HTML using class-validator.
//
// The server JSON delegated validation to the global ValidationPipe: in the event
// an error occurred, it would respond with a 400 Bad Request error code itself—which is appropriate for a
// JavaScript client, which then displays the error in its own way. For a page
// HTML, on the other hand, we want RÉAFFICHER the form to appear with the values
// already entered and a message below each invalid field. So we call
// `class-validator` ourselves, to retain control over what happens next.
// =========================================================================

import { ClassConstructor, plainToInstance } from 'class-transformer';
import { validate } from 'class-validator';
import { TITRES } from '../models/formulaire-personne.dto';

// errors by field: { name: 'ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED', ... } - each
// message is a translation (see the DTO decorators)
export type ErreursFormulaire = Record<string, string>;

export interface ResultatValidation<T> {
  dto: T; // the data, converted and cleaned (see @Transform in DTO)
  erreurs: ErreursFormulaire | null; // null = valid form
}

export async function validerFormulaire<T extends object>(
  classe: ClassConstructor<T>,
  corps: Record<string, unknown>,
): Promise<ResultatValidation<T>> {
   // plainToInstance: transforms the received simple object ({ name: 'dupont' })
   // into an instance of the DTO class, by applying its @Transform(...)
  const dto = plainToInstance(classe, corps);
   // validate: checks all constraints (@IsNotEmpty, @MaxLength...);
   // forbidUnknownValues:false because we are validating an object we created
  const violations = await validate(dto, { forbidUnknownValues: false });
  if (violations.length === 0) {
    return { dto, erreurs: null };
  }
  const erreurs: ErreursFormulaire = {};
  for (const violation of violations) {
     // we only keep the first message for each field
    erreurs[violation.property] = Object.values(violation.constraints ?? {})[0] ?? 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM';
  }
  return { dto, erreurs };
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// the form fields affected by each business "data entry" error
// (a duplicate): these are highlighted in red, with the message at the bottom of the page
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
export const CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER: Record<string, string[]> = {
  'ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN': ['login'],
  'ERRORS.DOCTOR_ALREADY_EXISTS': ['prenom', 'nom'],
  'ERRORS.PATIENT_ALREADY_EXISTS': ['prenom', 'nom'],
};

// { first_name: true, last_name: true }: the fields to be highlighted in red (is-invalid) -
// those with a validation message, plus any others
export function champsInvalides(erreurs: ErreursFormulaire, autres: string[] = []): Record<string, boolean> {
  const champs: Record<string, boolean> = {};
  for (const champ of [...Object.keys(erreurs), ...autres]) {
    champs[champ] = true;
  }
  return champs;
}

// the options in the "Title" drop-down list; the one selected in [valeur]
export function optionsTitres(valeur: string): { valeur: string; selectionne: boolean }[] {
  return TITRES.map((t) => ({ valeur: t, selectionne: t === valeur }));
}
  • lines 27–30: Form validation, as in Example 19. The option [forbidUnknownValues: false] is required because we are validating an object generated by [plainToInstance], not one received from [ValidationPipe];
  • lines 52–56: certain business errors relate to specific fields (e.g., a username that is already taken): these fields will be highlighted in red, with the message appearing at the bottom of the page;
  • lines 60–66: the fields to be highlighted in red;
  • lines 69–71: the options in the list of titles, with the selected one highlighted (see example 18).

// =========================================================================
// web/helpers/dates.helper.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Simple functions for dates in the "yyyy-MM-dd" format (the same as the
// rv.jour column and the <input type="date"> field in forms).
// =========================================================================

// Today's date: defined in the business layer, which needs it for
// its business rules—it is simply re-exported here
export { aujourdhui } from '../../metier/dates';

// true if [jour] is a valid date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
// (same check as the JSON server: "2026-02-30" is rejected)
export function estUneDateValide(jour: unknown): jour is string {
  if (typeof jour !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(jour)) {
    return false;
  }
  const date = new Date(`${jour}T00:00:00Z`);
  return !isNaN(date.getTime()) && date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === jour;
}

// "8:05" rather than "8:5"
export function formaterHeure(h: number, m: number): string {
  return `${h}:${deuxChiffres(m)}`;
}

// "Wednesday, September 23, 2026" / "mercredi 23 septembre 2026", depending on the language
// (Intl.DateTimeFormat: the date formatting API embedded in JavaScript)
export function formaterJour(jour: string, langue: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(langue === 'en' ? 'en-GB' : 'fr-FR', {
    dateStyle: 'full',
    timeZone: 'UTC', // "2026-09-23T00:00:00Z" must remain 23, regardless of the server's time zone
  }).format(new Date(`${jour}T00:00:00Z`));
}

function deuxChiffres(n: number): string {
  return n.toString().padStart(2, '0');
}
  • Line 10: The current date is defined in the business layer; this module re-exports it: controllers import all date functions from a single location;
  • lines 14–20: a [aaaa-mm-jj] date that exists (see Example 12);
  • lines 29–34: a date spelled out in full, depending on the language. The [timeZone: 'UTC'] option prevents a one-day offset when the server is not set to Greenwich Mean Time.

// =========================================================================
// web/controllers/langue.controller.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GET /language/fr, GET /language/en: the two buttons FR / EN on the
// navigation bar. The selection is stored in a cookie (the Angular client
// stored it in localStorage), and then you are redirected back to the page you came from.
// Unsecured route: you should be able to change the language before logging in.
// =========================================================================

import { Controller, Get, NotFoundException, Param, Req, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { estUneLangue } from '../i18n';
import { COOKIE_LANGUE } from '../contexte-vue';

const UN_AN = 365 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;

@Controller('langue')
export class LangueController {
  @Get(':langue')
  changer(@Param('langue') langue: string, @Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): void {
    if (!estUneLangue(langue)) {
      throw new NotFoundException();
    }
    res.cookie(COOKIE_LANGUE, langue, { maxAge: UN_AN, sameSite: 'lax', httpOnly: true });
    res.redirect(pageDOrigine(req));
  }
}

// the previous page, based on the "Referer" header HTTP sent by the
// browser. We only keep the path (/agenda?...): redirect to
// a complete address provided by the request would allow us to send
// the user to another site (a vulnerability known as an “open redirect”).
function pageDOrigine(req: Request): string {
  const referer = req.get('referer');
  if (!referer) {
    return '/';
  }
  try {
    const url = new URL(referer);
    return url.pathname.startsWith('/langue/') ? '/' : url.pathname + url.search;
  } catch {
    return '/';
  }
}

The controller from Example 22. Note: if the original page is itself a [/langue/...] page (line 40), the request is redirected to the site’s root to prevent an infinite loop.

// =========================================================================
// web/controllers/agenda.controller.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The calendar page: selecting a doctor and a day, that
// doctor’s schedule for that day, booking and canceling appointments.
// This is the server-side equivalent of the Angular components
// <app-doctor-day-picker>, <app-agenda>, and <app-booking-dialog>.
//
//    GE T /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-09-2             3 the page
//    GE T /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-09-23&book=7     the same page, with
//                                                           the booking window
//                                                           for time slot 7 is open
//    POST /calendar/book                                   creates an appointment
//    POST /calendar/canc                                  el cancels an appointment
//
// The entire page is described by its URL: you can reload it, add it
// bookmark it, or use the browser’s “Back” button—without a single line
// of JavaScript.
//
// What everyone sees and can do:
//
//    | rol         e | displayed re           served slot           | Reserve | Cancel |
//   |---------------|-----------------------------------|--------------------|---------|
//    | ADMIN, DOCTOR | patient name                         | for     a patient | yes |
//                  |                                    |            | selected from list | |
//    | USER (patient)| “Reserved,” or SON name if it i s | for himself, if he| no (*) |
//                  | | his own            appointment          | does not already have an appointment| |
//                  |                                                         | | upcoming | |
//
//    (*) The patient cancels their appointment from their "My Account" page.
//
// CONFIDENTIALITÉ: for a patient, the names of the AUTRES patients are not
// simply hidden by the view—it is never included in the template
// passed to the view. The HTML sent to the browser therefore does not contain it,
// nor is it hidden (otherwise, simply “View Source” would reveal it).
//
// No reservations in the past: the “Reserve” button only appears
// for today and the following days (and the business layer would reject it
// in any case).
// =========================================================================

import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, Post, Query, Render, Req, Res, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { ApplicationModelService } from '../application-model.service';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../../auth/roles.guard';
import { Roles } from '../../auth/roles.decorator';
import { UtilisateurConnecte } from '../../auth/jwt.strategy';
import { MetierException } from '../../metier/metier.exception';
import { flash } from '../contexte-vue';
import { aujourdhui, estUneDateValide, formaterHeure } from '../helpers/dates.helper';
import { libelle, patientConnecte } from '../helpers/patient.helper';
import { Client } from '../../entities/client.entity';
import { Personne } from '../../entities/personne.entity';

type RequeteAuthentifiee = Request & { user: UtilisateurConnecte };

// ----------------------------------------------------------------- view template
// (what views/agenda.hbs displays—only data already
// ET format that has already been filtered by role: the view doesn’t decide anything)

interface OptionVue {
  id: number;
  libelle: string; // "Ms. Marie PELISSIER"
  selectionne: boolean;
}

interface LigneAgendaVue {
  idCreneau: number;
  horaire: string; // "8:00 - 8:20"
  libre: boolean;
  patient: string | null; // displayed name for a booked slot; null = “Reserved”
  moi: boolean; // the appointment for the logged-in patient
  reservable: boolean; // Display the "Book" button?
  urlReserver: string;
  idRv: number | null; // populated only if the "Cancel" button is displayed
}

interface AgendaVue {
  medecin: string;
  jour: string;
  lignes: LigneAgendaVue[];
}

interface ReservationVue {
  idCreneau: number;
  horaire: string;
   // ADMIN / DOCTOR: the list of patients to choose from
  clients: OptionVue[];
   // USER: the patient is the patient themselves
  patient: string | null;
}

export interface ModeleAgenda {
  titrePage: string;
  medecins: OptionVue[];
  idMedecin: number | null;
  jour: string;
  agenda: AgendaVue | null;
  reservation: ReservationVue | null;
  urlRetour: string; // the displayed calendar, without a booking window
   // Patient who already has an upcoming appointment: the explanatory message
   // why there is no “Book” button
  info: string | null;
  erreur: string | null;
}

// what the controller knows about the user to determine the display
interface Droits {
  gestionnaire: boolean; // ADMIN or DOCTOR
  patient: Client | null; // the logged-in client (role USER), otherwise null
  patientPeutReserver: boolean; // USER with no upcoming appointments
}

@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Controller('agenda')
export class AgendaController {
  constructor(private readonly application: ApplicationModelService) {}

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // GET /calendar
   // @Render('calendar'): the object returned by the method becomes the template for
   // the view views/agenda.hbs (+ the content of res.locals; see contexte-vue.ts).
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get()
  @Render('agenda')
  async afficher(
    @Req() req: RequeteAuthentifiee,
    @Query('idMedecin') idMedecinBrut?: string,
    @Query('jour') jourBrut?: string,
    @Query('reserver') reserverBrut?: string,
  ): Promise<ModeleAgenda> {
    let erreur: string | null = null;
    const droits = await this.droits(req.user);

     // the day: the day of URL if it is valid, otherwise today
    let jour = aujourdhui();
    if (jourBrut !== undefined) {
      if (estUneDateValide(jourBrut)) {
        jour = jourBrut;
      } else {
        erreur = 'ERRORS.INVALID_DATE';
      }
    }
    const jourReservable = jour >= aujourdhui();

     // the doctor: the one from URL; otherwise, for a logged-in doctor, the doctor themselves
    let idMedecin = entierPositif(idMedecinBrut);
    if (idMedecinBrut === undefined && req.user.role === 'DOCTOR') {
      idMedecin = this.application.getMedecinByUserId(req.user.userId)?.id ?? null;
    }

    const medecins = (await this.application.getAllMedecins()).map((m) => option(m, m.id === idMedecin));

     // the calendar, if a doctor is selected (and the date is valid)
    let agenda: AgendaVue | null = null;
    if (idMedecin !== null && erreur === null) {
      const agendaMedecin = await this.application.getAgendaMedecinJour(idMedecin, jour);
      if (agendaMedecin === null) {
        erreur = 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND';
      } else {
        agenda = {
          medecin: libelle(agendaMedecin.medecin),
          jour,
          lignes: agendaMedecin.creneauxMedecinJour.map(({ creneau, rv }) => {
            const libre = rv === null;
             // the logged-in patient’s appointment?
            const moi = !libre && droits.patient !== null && rv.idClient === droits.patient.id;
            return {
              idCreneau: creneau.id,
              horaire: `${formaterHeure(creneau.hdebut, creneau.mdebut)} - ${formaterHeure(creneau.hfin, creneau.mfin)}`,
              libre,
               // LE privacy setting: a patient only receives the name
               // for the SON appointment; for others, null (the view displays “Reserved”)
              patient: libre ? null : droits.gestionnaire || moi ? libelle(rv.client) : null,
              moi,
              reservable: libre && jourReservable && (droits.gestionnaire || droits.patientPeutReserver),
              urlReserver: urlAgenda(idMedecin as number, jour, creneau.id),
              idRv: !libre && droits.gestionnaire ? rv.id : null,
            };
          }),
        };
      }
    }

     // the booking window: only if the requested time slot is
     // bookable by this user
    let reservation: ReservationVue | null = null;
    const idCreneau = entierPositif(reserverBrut);
    const ligne = agenda?.lignes.find((l) => l.idCreneau === idCreneau && l.reservable);
    if (ligne) {
      reservation = {
        idCreneau: ligne.idCreneau,
        horaire: ligne.horaire,
        clients: droits.gestionnaire ? (await this.application.getAllClients()).map((c) => option(c, false)) : [],
        patient: droits.patient ? libelle(droits.patient) : null,
      };
    }

    return {
      titrePage: 'AGENDA.PAGE_TITLE',
      medecins,
      idMedecin,
      jour,
      agenda,
      reservation,
      urlRetour: idMedecin !== null ? urlAgenda(idMedecin, jour) : '/agenda',
      info: droits.patient !== null && !droits.patientPeutReserver ? 'AGENDA.ALREADY_BOOKED_INFO' : null,
      erreur,
    };
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /calendar/book    fields: idMedecin, day, idCreneau, idClient
  //
   // For a patient (USER), the field idClient is IGNORÉ: the patient books
   // always reserves for himself. Trusting a field sent by the
   // browser would allow a malicious patient to make a reservation in someone else’s name.
  //
   // "Post/Redirect/Get" pattern: regardless of the result, we do not
   // create a page here—we post a flash message and redirect
   // to the calendar (see flash(), contexte-vue.ts).
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('reserver')
  @Roles('ADMIN', 'DOCTOR', 'USER')
  async reserver(
    @Body() body: Record<string, string>,
    @Req() req: RequeteAuthentifiee,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const { idMedecin, jour } = lireAgendaDemande(body);
    const idCreneau = entierPositif(body.idCreneau);
    if (idCreneau === null) {
      throw new BadRequestException();
    }

    let client: Client | null;
    if (req.user.role === 'USER') {
      client = await patientConnecte(this.application, req.user);
    } else {
      const idClient = entierPositif(body.idClient);
      if (idClient === null) {
         // no patient selected: we reopen the appointment window
        flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT' });
        return res.redirect(urlAgenda(idMedecin, jour, idCreneau));
      }
      client = await this.application.getClientById(idClient);
    }

    const creneau = await this.application.getCreneauById(idCreneau);
    if (client === null) {
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else if (creneau === null || creneau.idMedecin !== idMedecin) {
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.SLOT_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else {
      try {
         // the rules (not in the past, only one upcoming appointment per
         // patient, available time slot) are verified by the business logic layer
        await this.application.ajouterRv(jour, creneau, client);
        flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: 'AGENDA.BOOKED' });
      } catch (e) {
         // same rule, but a message to the second person when the patient
         // the patient makes the appointment themselves (“You already have...” rather than “This patient...”)
        if (
          req.user.role === 'USER' &&
          e instanceof MetierException &&
          e.cle === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_HAS_UPCOMING_APPOINTMENT'
        ) {
          flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'AGENDA.ALREADY_BOOKED_INFO' });
        } else {
          flashErreurMetier(res, e);
        }
      }
    }
    res.redirect(urlAgenda(idMedecin, jour));
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /calendar/canc  el fields: idRv, idMedecin, day
   // (a patient cancels SON an appointment from “My Account,” not from here)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('annuler')
  @Roles('ADMIN', 'DOCTOR')
  async annuler(@Body() body: Record<string, string>, @Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const { idMedecin, jour } = lireAgendaDemande(body);
    const idRv = entierPositif(body.idRv);
    if (idRv === null) {
      throw new BadRequestException();
    }
    const rv = await this.application.getRvById(idRv);
    if (rv === null) {
       // already canceled (by someone else, or by double-clicking)
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else {
      await this.application.supprimerRv(rv);
      flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: 'AGENDA.CANCELLED' });
    }
    res.redirect(urlAgenda(idMedecin, jour));
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // Who is logged in, and what permissions do they have on this page?
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  private async droits(utilisateur: UtilisateurConnecte): Promise<Droits> {
    if (utilisateur.role !== 'USER') {
      return { gestionnaire: true, patient: null, patientPeutReserver: false };
    }
    const patient = await patientConnecte(this.application, utilisateur);
    const rvAVenir = await this.application.getRvAVenirClient(patient.id);
    return { gestionnaire: false, patient, patientPeutReserver: rvAVenir.length === 0 };
  }
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------- utility functions

// "3" -> 3; "", "abc", "-2", undefined -> null
function entierPositif(valeur: unknown): number | null {
  const n = Number(valeur);
  return typeof valeur === 'string' && valeur !== '' && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : null;
}

// the hidden fields idMedecin / day, common to both forms POST
function lireAgendaDemande(body: Record<string, string>): { idMedecin: number; jour: string } {
  const idMedecin = entierPositif(body.idMedecin);
  if (idMedecin === null || !estUneDateValide(body.jour)) {
    throw new BadRequestException(); // -> "invalid request" page (see HtmlExceptionFilter)
  }
  return { idMedecin, jour: body.jour };
}

function urlAgenda(idMedecin: number, jour: string, reserver?: number): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ idMedecin: String(idMedecin), jour });
  if (reserver !== undefined) {
    params.set('reserver', String(reserver));
  }
  return `/agenda?${params.toString()}`;
}

function option(p: Personne, selectionne: boolean): OptionVue {
  return { id: p.id, libelle: libelle(p), selectionne };
}

// a MetierException becomes a flash message; any other error is a
// a true anomaly, which is escalated to HtmlExceptionFilter
function flashErreurMetier(res: Response, e: unknown): void {
  if (e instanceof MetierException) {
    flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: e.cle, params: e.params });
    return;
  }
  throw e;
}

The application’s main page. Let’s walk through this code section by section.

docs.title: 11.14.2.1. The URL section of the page
docs.text: The comments on lines 9–14 describe the routes. Note that the booking window is not opened by [JavaScript]: it is a parameter of URL ([reserver=7]) that instructs the server to display the page with the window open. The “Book” button is therefore simply a link. The entire page is described by its URL: you can reload it, bookmark it, or use the browser’s “Back” button.

docs.title: 11.14.2.2. The view template
docs.text:
• line 56: the type of request for a protected route: a [Express] request whose [user] field was submitted by [JwtAuthGuard];
  • lines 62–106: The view template is typed. The view receives only data that has already been formatted ([horaire: "8:00 - 8:20"]) and filtered according to the user’s role; it does not make any decisions. In [LigneAgendaVue] (lines 68–77), [patient] is equal to [null] when the user does not have permission to view the patient’s name; [reservable] and [idRv] determine whether the “Reserve” and “Cancel” buttons should be displayed;
  • lines 109–113: what the controller knows about the logged-in user.

docs.title: 11.14.2.3. GET /agenda
docs.text:
• lines 115–116: All routes require a logged-in user. Without [@Roles] on the class, all roles have access to the page;
  • lines 127–132: the three parameters of URL, all optional, received as strings and converted later;
  • lines 137–145: the requested date, if valid; otherwise, today. Appointments can only be booked starting today;
  • lines 148–151: the requested doctor; otherwise, a logged-in doctor sees their own schedule;
  • line 153: the drop-down list of doctors, retrieved from the cache;
  • lines 157–184: the calendar, calculated by the business layer, is converted into table rows. Line 175 is the application’s privacy checkpoint: a patient receives only the name of their own appointment. For others, the model contains [null], and the view displays “Reserved.” The name is not simply hidden by the view: it is never sent to the browser;
  • lines 188–198: the booking window opens only if the requested time slot is bookable by that user. An administrator selects the patient from a list; a patient books for themselves;
  • lines 200–210: The template [info] explains to a patient who already has an appointment why they do not see a “Book” button.

docs.title: 11.14.2.4. POST /agenda/reserver
docs.text:
• line 225: all three roles can make a reservation;
  • line 231: the “doctor” and “day” fields—which are hidden in the form—allow the user to return to the displayed calendar;
  • lines 238–239: For a patient, the field [idClient] is ignored: the patient always books for themselves. Relying on this field, which is sent by the browser, would allow a crafty patient to book on behalf of someone else;

// =========================================================================
// web/controllers/personnes.controller.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The management of doctors and clients (reserved for ADMIN) are
// IDENTIQUES: same list, same form, same rules. Rather than
// writing the same routes twice, we write them once in this
// class ABSTRAITE, from which MedecinsController (@Controller('doctors'))
// and ClientsController (@Controller('clients')). Each subclass does not
// to provide its “configuration”: which methods to call, which
// labels to display.
//
// The route decorators (@Get, @Post...) applied ICI are inherited: NestJS
// traverses the entire chain of prototypes in the controller class. It
// Thus, for each of the two subclasses, we obtain:
//
//    GE T /doctor                  s list
//    GE T /doctors/add            empty form
//    POST /doctors/add            create
//    GE T /doctors/:id/edit       pre-filled form
//    POST /doctors/:id/edit       edit
//    POST /doctors/:id/delete      deletion
//
// (and the same URL under /clients). The views are also shared:
// views/people/liste.hbs and views/people/formulaire.hbs.
// =========================================================================

import { Body, Get, HttpCode, NotFoundException, Param, ParseIntPipe, Post, Render, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Response } from 'express';
import { ApplicationModelService } from '../application-model.service';
import { DonneesPersonne } from '../../metier/metier.interface';
import { MetierException } from '../../metier/metier.exception';
import { Personne } from '../../entities/personne.entity';
import { flash } from '../contexte-vue';
import {
  CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER,
  ErreursFormulaire,
  champsInvalides,
  optionsTitres,
  validerFormulaire,
} from '../helpers/formulaire.helper';
import { FormulairePersonneDto } from '../models/formulaire-personne.dto';

// the translation keys specific to each person type
export interface ClesPersonnes {
  titre: string; // "Doctors"
  ajouter: string; // "Add a doctor"
  modifier: string; // "Edit a doctor"
  vide: string; // "No doctors."
  confirmerSuppression: string; // "Delete this doctor and their account?"
  ajoute: string; // "The doctor {name} has been added (login: {login})."
  modifie: string;
  supprime: string;
}

export interface ConfigPersonnes<T extends Personne> {
  url: string; // '/doctors' or '/clients'
  cles: ClesPersonnes;
  lister(): Promise<T[]>;
  trouver(id: number): Promise<T | null>;
  ajouter(donnees: DonneesPersonne): Promise<T>;
  modifier(id: number, donnees: DonneesPersonne): Promise<T>;
  supprimer(id: number): Promise<void>;
}

// the values displayed in the form fields
interface ValeursFormulaire {
  titre: string;
  prenom: string;
  nom: string;
  login: string;
  version: number | null;
}

export abstract class PersonnesController<T extends Personne> {
  protected abstract readonly config: ConfigPersonnes<T>;

  constructor(protected readonly application: ApplicationModelService) {}

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // GET /doctors (or /clients)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get()
  @Render('personnes/liste')
  async liste() {
    const personnes = await this.config.lister();
    return {
      titrePage: this.config.cles.titre,
      cles: this.config.cles,
      urlAjouter: `${this.config.url}/ajouter`,
      personnes: personnes.map((p) => ({
        titre: p.titre,
        prenom: p.prenom,
        nom: p.nom,
        login: p.user?.login ?? '',
        urlModifier: `${this.config.url}/${p.id}/modifier`,
        urlSupprimer: `${this.config.url}/${p.id}/supprimer`,
      })),
    };
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // GET /doctors/add
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('ajouter')
  formulaireAjout(@Res() res: Response): void {
    this.afficherFormulaire(res, null, { titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', version: null });
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /doctors/add
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('ajouter')
  @HttpCode(200) // if the form is redisplayed (see auth.controller.ts)
  async ajouter(@Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const { dto, erreurs } = await validerFormulaire(FormulairePersonneDto, body);
    if (erreurs !== null) {
      return this.afficherFormulaire(res, null, valeursSaisies(dto), erreurs);
    }
    try {
      const personne = await this.config.ajouter(dto);
      flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: this.config.cles.ajoute, params: parametres(personne) });
      res.redirect(this.config.url);
    } catch (e) {
      this.afficherErreurMetier(res, null, valeursSaisies(dto), e);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // GET /doctors/:id/edit
   // ParseIntPipe: if :id is not an integer, NestJS raises an
   // BadRequestException (“invalid request” page; see HtmlExceptionFilter)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get(':id/modifier')
  async formulaireModification(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const personne = await this.config.trouver(id);
    if (personne === null) {
      throw new NotFoundException();
    }
    this.afficherFormulaire(res, id, {
      titre: personne.titre,
      prenom: personne.prenom,
      nom: personne.nom,
      login: personne.user?.login ?? '',
      version: personne.version,
    });
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /doctors/:id/edit
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post(':id/modifier')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async modifier(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const { dto, erreurs } = await validerFormulaire(FormulairePersonneDto, body);
    if (erreurs !== null) {
      return this.afficherFormulaire(res, id, valeursSaisies(dto), erreurs);
    }
    try {
      const personne = await this.config.modifier(id, dto);
      flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: this.config.cles.modifie, params: parametres(personne) });
      res.redirect(this.config.url);
    } catch (e) {
      this.afficherErreurMetier(res, id, valeursSaisies(dto), e);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /doctors/:id/delete
   // (The browser prompts for confirmation with "Are you sure?" before
   // the form is submitted; see public/js/app.js)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post(':id/supprimer')
  async supprimer(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number, @Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const personne = await this.config.trouver(id);
    try {
      await this.config.supprimer(id);
      flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: this.config.cles.supprime, params: parametres(personne) });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof MetierException)) {
        throw e;
      }
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: e.cle, params: e.params });
    }
    res.redirect(this.config.url);
  }

   // ----------------------------------------------------------------- private methods

   // id === null: create form; otherwise: update form
   /  / erro        rs : message below each field rejected by validation
   /  / err         or : LE page error message, displayed at the bottom of the page
   /                    / (see views/partials/erreurs.hbs)
   /  / autresCha   mps : fields to be highlighted in red SANS custom message (e.g.,
   /                    / first name + last name of a namesake—the message appears at the bottom of the page)
  private afficherFormulaire(
    res: Response,
    id: number | null,
    valeurs: ValeursFormulaire,
    erreurs: ErreursFormulaire = {},
    erreur: string | null = null,
    autresChamps: string[] = [],
  ): void {
    const creation = id === null;
    res.render('personnes/formulaire', {
      titrePage: creation ? this.config.cles.ajouter : this.config.cles.modifier,
      creation,
      action: creation ? `${this.config.url}/ajouter` : `${this.config.url}/${id}/modifier`,
      urlListe: this.config.url,
      valeurs,
      titres: optionsTitres(valeurs.titre),
      erreurs,
      champsInvalides: champsInvalides(erreurs, autresChamps),
      erreur: erreur ?? (Object.keys(erreurs).length > 0 ? 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM' : null),
    });
  }

   // A business rule rejected the save: the form is redisplayed,
   // with the user’s input and the business-layer message
  private afficherErreurMetier(res: Response, id: number | null, valeurs: ValeursFormulaire, e: unknown): void {
    if (!(e instanceof MetierException)) {
      throw e; // true error -> HtmlExceptionFilter (page 500)
    }
    if (e.cle === 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND' || e.cle === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND') {
       // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: return to the list
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: e.cle });
      return res.redirect(this.config.url);
    }
     // the message moves to the bottom of the page; the affected fields, if any, are
     // highlighted in red so the user can immediately see what to correct
    this.afficherFormulaire(res, id, valeurs, {}, e.cle, CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[e.cle] ?? []);
  }
}

// what the user entered (excluding the password: it is never sent back to the browser)
function valeursSaisies(dto: FormulairePersonneDto): ValeursFormulaire {
  return {
    titre: dto.titre ?? '',
    prenom: typeof dto.prenom === 'string' ? dto.prenom : '',
    nom: typeof dto.nom === 'string' ? dto.nom : '',
    login: dto.login ?? '',
    version: dto.version ?? null,
  };
}

// {name} and {login} from the “added / modified / deleted” messages
function parametres(personne: Personne | null): Record<string, string> {
  if (personne === null) {
    return { nom: '', login: '' };
  }
  return { nom: `${personne.prenom} ${personne.nom}`, login: personne.user?.login ?? '' };
}

The handling of doctors and clients is identical. Rather than writing two similar controllers, we create an abstract class from which both controllers inherit.

  • lines 44–53: the texts specific to each type of person (translation keys);
  • lines 55–63: the configuration provided by each subclass: the base URL, the texts, and the functions to call for listing, searching, adding, modifying, and deleting;
  • line 75: an abstract field: each subclass must define it;
  • lines 82–99: the list. Route decorators applied to a parent class are inherited: [NestJS] finds them by traversing the prototype chain. The model contains, for each person, the URL for their buttons;
  • lines 104–107 and 112–126: the addition, in three steps, as in Example 28: validation, business layer, PRG;
  • lines 133–146 and 151–157: modification. [ParseIntPipe] rejects a non-numeric identifier (error 400);
  • lines 176–189: deletion. The person is retrieved beforehand to display their name in the confirmation message;
  • lines 199–206: the form, for both creation ([id === null]) and modification;
  • lines 223–235: a person who has been deleted in the meantime is returned to the list; other business errors redisplay the form, with the relevant fields highlighted in red;
  • lines 239–247: the values to be redisplayed (never the password).

// =========================================================================
// web/controllers/medecins.controller.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Physician management (ADMIN role only). All routes are
// inherited from PersonnesController (see personnes.controller.ts): all that
// remains here to note that the labels “Call” and “Display” are used.
//
// @Roles('ADMIN') applied to CLASSE applies to all its routes,
// including inherited ones (RolesGuard looks for metadata on the method,
// and then on the class—see auth/roles.guard.ts).
// =========================================================================

import { Controller, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../../auth/roles.guard';
import { Roles } from '../../auth/roles.decorator';
import { ApplicationModelService } from '../application-model.service';
import { Medecin } from '../../entities/medecin.entity';
import { ConfigPersonnes, PersonnesController } from './personnes.controller';

@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles('ADMIN')
@Controller('medecins')
export class MedecinsController extends PersonnesController<Medecin> {
  protected readonly config: ConfigPersonnes<Medecin> = {
    url: '/medecins',
    cles: {
      titre: 'MEDECINS.TITLE',
      ajouter: 'MEDECINS.ADD',
      modifier: 'MEDECINS.EDIT',
      vide: 'MEDECINS.EMPTY',
      confirmerSuppression: 'MEDECINS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
      ajoute: 'MEDECINS.ADDED',
      modifie: 'MEDECINS.UPDATED',
      supprime: 'MEDECINS.DELETED',
    },
    lister: () => this.application.getAllMedecins(),
    trouver: (id) => this.application.getMedecinById(id),
    ajouter: (donnees) => this.application.ajouterMedecin(donnees),
    modifier: (id, donnees) => this.application.modifierMedecin(id, donnees),
    supprimer: (id) => this.application.supprimerMedecin(id),
  };

   // an explicit constructor, so that TypeScript can generate the class on CETTE
   // the type metadata for the parameters, which NestJS needs to
   // determine what to inject (the parent class, which is abstract and has no decorator,
   // does not have one)
  constructor(application: ApplicationModelService) {
    super(application);
  }
}
  • lines 21–22: reserved for ADMIN. [@Roles] applied to the class applies to all its routes, including inherited ones;
  • lines 25–42: the configuration: the translation keys for doctors, and the cache methods to call;
  • lines 48–50: an explicit constructor, even though it merely calls the parent class’s constructor; this is what allows the compiler to generate, for this class, the type metadata that [NestJS] needs to know what to inject.
