docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// web/controllers/inscription.controller.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// "Create a customer account": a patient who does not yet have an account
// creates one themselves. Protected routes NON (we don’t have an account yet, as
// definition):
//
//    POST /registration/acc  ess "Create a customer account" button on the
//                              authentication page: verifies the CAPTCHA from
//                              CETTE page, then opens the form
//    GE T /registrat        ion the form
//    POST /registrati        on the registration process, then returns to the login page
//
// The process is protected against bots by the UN CAPTCHA on the
// authentication page:
//    1. The "Create a Customer Account" button sends the login form
//       to /registration/access; if the CAPTCHA is entered correctly, the server
//       issues a token (see auth/passe-inscription.service.ts);
//    2. Without a valid passcode, /registration redirects to the
//       authentication page—entering URL directly does nothing;
//    3. The pass is used up upon creation: a solved CAPTCHA
//       allows you to create UN an account;
//    4. Additionally, the number of accounts created per hour per IP address is
//       limited (see auth/limiteur-tentatives.service.ts).
//
// The account created is exactly the one that ADMIN would create from the
// "Clients" page (same business-layer method: ajouterClient), except
// the patient must enter their login and password (required, with
// confirmation).
// =========================================================================

import { Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, Post, Req, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { ApplicationModelService } from '../application-model.service';
import { CaptchaService } from '../../auth/captcha.service';
import { LimiteurTentativesService } from '../../auth/limiteur-tentatives.service';
import { COOKIE_PASSE_INSCRIPTION, PasseInscriptionService } from '../../auth/passe-inscription.service';
import { MetierException } from '../../metier/metier.exception';
import { flash } from '../contexte-vue';
import {
  CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER,
  ErreursFormulaire,
  champsInvalides,
  optionsTitres,
  validerFormulaire,
} from '../helpers/formulaire.helper';
import { FormulaireInscriptionDto, MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN } from '../models/formulaire-personne.dto';

interface ValeursInscription {
  titre: string;
  prenom: string;
  nom: string;
  login: string;
}

@Controller('inscription')
export class InscriptionController {
  constructor(
    private readonly application: ApplicationModelService,
    private readonly captchaService: CaptchaService,
    private readonly limiteur: LimiteurTentativesService,
    private readonly passes: PasseInscriptionService,
  ) {}

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /registration/acc  ess fields: captchaId, captcha (those on the
   // authentication page; username and password, which are also sent, are ignored)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('acces')
  acces(@Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): void {
    const ip = req.ip ?? 'inconnue';

     // too many accounts created recently from this address: no need to proceed further
    const minutes = this.limiteur.minutesBlocageInscription(ip);
    if (minutes > 0) {
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ACCOUNTS', params: { minutes: String(minutes) } });
      return res.redirect('/login');
    }

     // captcha missing or incorrect: return to the authentication page, with
     // a new image (one failure counts as a failed login attempt)
    if (!this.captchaService.verifier(body.captchaId, body.captcha)) {
      this.limiteur.echecLogin(ip, '');
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT' });
      return res.redirect('/login');
    }

     // Correct CAPTCHA: Grant access and open the form
    res.cookie(COOKIE_PASSE_INSCRIPTION, this.passes.emettre(), this.passes.optionsCookie());
    res.redirect('/inscription');
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // GET /registration
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get()
  formulaire(@Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): void {
    if (!this.aUnLaissezPasser(req, res)) {
      return;
    }
    this.afficher(res, { titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '' });
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /registration
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post()
  @HttpCode(200) // if the form is re-displayed (see auth.controller.ts)
  async creer(@Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.aUnLaissezPasser(req, res)) {
      return;
    }
    const ip = req.ip ?? 'inconnue';
    const { dto, erreurs } = await validerFormulaire(FormulaireInscriptionDto, body);
    const valeurs: ValeursInscription = {
      titre: dto.titre ?? 'Mr',
      prenom: typeof dto.prenom === 'string' ? dto.prenom : '',
      nom: typeof dto.nom === 'string' ? dto.nom : '',
      login: dto.login ?? '',
    };

     // 1. Have too many accounts been created recently from this address?
    const minutes = this.limiteur.minutesBlocageInscription(ip);
    if (minutes > 0) {
      return this.afficher(res, valeurs, {}, 'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ACCOUNTS', [], { minutes: String(minutes) });
    }

     // 2. All data entry errors at once (fields + confirmation):
         // the user corrects them all at once
    const toutesErreurs: ErreursFormulaire = { ...(erreurs ?? {}) };
    if (!toutesErreurs.password && !toutesErreurs.confirmation && dto.password !== dto.confirmation) {
      toutesErreurs.confirmation = 'ERRORS.PASSWORDS_DIFFER';
    }
    if (Object.keys(toutesErreurs).length > 0) {
      return this.afficher(res, valeurs, toutesErreurs);
    }

     // 3. Account creation (customer + account USER, in a single transaction)
    try {
      await this.application.ajouterClient({
        titre: dto.titre,
        nom: dto.nom,
        prenom: dto.prenom,
        login: dto.login,
        password: dto.password,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof MetierException)) {
        throw e;
      }
       // username or first name + last name already taken: the pass remains valid
      return this.afficher(res, valeurs, {}, e.cle, CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[e.cle] ?? []);
    }

     // 4. The password has been used: it will not allow the creation of a second account
    this.passes.consommer(req.cookies?.[COOKIE_PASSE_INSCRIPTION]);
    res.clearCookie(COOKIE_PASSE_INSCRIPTION, { path: '/inscription' });
    this.limiteur.inscriptionReussie(ip);

     // 5. Return to the login page; username is pre-filled
    flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: 'INSCRIPTION.DONE', params: { login: dto.login } });
    res.redirect(`/login?${new URLSearchParams({ login: dto.login }).toString()}`);
  }

   // ----------------------------------------------------------------- private methods

   // No valid credentials: Return to the authentication page
  private aUnLaissezPasser(req: Request, res: Response): boolean {
    if (this.passes.estValide(req.cookies?.[COOKIE_PASSE_INSCRIPTION])) {
      return true;
    }
    flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT' });
    res.redirect('/login');
    return false;
  }

   // the form; no password is ever sent back to the browser
  private afficher(
    res: Response,
    valeurs: ValeursInscription,
    erreurs: ErreursFormulaire = {},
    erreur: string | null = null,
    autresChamps: string[] = [],
    erreurParams?: Record<string, string>,
  ): void {
    res.render('compte/inscription', {
      titrePage: 'INSCRIPTION.TITLE',
      valeurs,
      titres: optionsTitres(valeurs.titre),
      erreurs,
      champsInvalides: champsInvalides(erreurs, autresChamps),
      erreur: erreur ?? (Object.keys(erreurs).length > 0 ? 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM' : null),
      erreurParams,
      motDePasseMin: MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN,
    });
  }
}

Let’s comment on this code:

  • lines 69–91: The “Create a Customer Account” button on the login page sends the login form to this address (attribute [formaction]; see Example 20). The page’s CAPTCHA is verified; if it’s correct, a token is stored in a cookie and the browser is redirected to the form;
  • lines 96–102: the form, but only with a valid token;
  • lines 109–163: account creation: token, time limit, validation (including verification that the password matches its confirmation), creation by the business layer. The token is then consumed, and the patient is redirected to the login page with their username pre-filled;
  • lines 168–175: without a pass, return to the login page with a message;
  • lines 178–185: the form. [motDePasseMin] is used for the help text (“At least 6 characters”).

docs.title: 11.14.7. src/web/controllers/espace-patient.controller.ts
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// web/controllers/espace-patient.controller.ts
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The patient's pages (role USER), the one they see right
// after logging in:
//
//    GE T /my-space               home page: [Gérer mon compte],
//                                   [Voir un agenda], and their upcoming appointment
//    POST /my-space/cancel        cancels the appointment SON
//    GE T /my-accou              nt account modification form
//    POST /my-accoun              t update
//    POST /my-account/delete      Delete account (and its appointments)
//
// Golden rule for this controller: the patient in question is TOUJOURS, the one associated with
// token (patientConnecte), never an identifier sent by the browser.
// A patient can therefore neither view, modify, nor cancel anything belonging
// to another patient, even by crafting their own requests.
//
// Any modification or deletion of the account requires the password
// ACTUEL: someone who finds a session that has been left open cannot
// change the password or delete the account. Password
// are counted as login failures (same limit).
// =========================================================================

import { Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, Post, Render, Req, Res, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { ApplicationModelService } from '../application-model.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../auth/auth.service';
import { LimiteurTentativesService } from '../../auth/limiteur-tentatives.service';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../../auth/roles.guard';
import { Roles } from '../../auth/roles.decorator';
import { UtilisateurConnecte } from '../../auth/jwt.strategy';
import { COOKIE_JWT, optionsCookieJwt } from '../../auth/auth.constants';
import { MetierException } from '../../metier/metier.exception';
import { Client } from '../../entities/client.entity';
import { flash } from '../contexte-vue';
import { formaterHeure, formaterJour } from '../helpers/dates.helper';
import { libelle, patientConnecte } from '../helpers/patient.helper';
import {
  CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER,
  ErreursFormulaire,
  champsInvalides,
  optionsTitres,
  validerFormulaire,
} from '../helpers/formulaire.helper';
import { FormulaireMonCompteDto, MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN } from '../models/formulaire-personne.dto';

type RequeteAuthentifiee = Request & { user: UtilisateurConnecte };

interface ValeursMonCompte {
  titre: string;
  prenom: string;
  nom: string;
  login: string;
  version: number | null;
}

@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles('USER')
@Controller()
export class EspacePatientController {
  constructor(
    private readonly application: ApplicationModelService,
    private readonly authService: AuthService,
    private readonly limiteur: LimiteurTentativesService,
  ) {}

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // GET /my-space
   // @Res({ passthrough: true }): the response is accessed (to read the language
   // in res.locals) SANS bypasses the normal operation of @Render.
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('mon-espace')
  @Render('patient/espace')
  async espace(@Req() req: RequeteAuthentifiee, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    const patient = await patientConnecte(this.application, req.user);
    const rendezVous = await this.application.getRvAVenirClient(patient.id);
    return {
      titrePage: 'ESPACE.TITLE',
      patient: libelle(patient),
      rendezVous: rendezVous.map((rv) => ({
        id: rv.id,
        jour: formaterJour(rv.jour, res.locals.lang),
        horaire: `${formaterHeure(rv.creneau.hdebut, rv.creneau.mdebut)} - ${formaterHeure(rv.creneau.hfin, rv.creneau.mfin)}`,
        medecin: libelle(rv.creneau.medecin),
         // link to the doctor’s schedule for that day: the patient sees their name there
        urlAgenda: `/agenda?${new URLSearchParams({ idMedecin: String(rv.creneau.medecin.id), jour: rv.jour })}`,
      })),
    };
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /my-space/cancel    field: idRv
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('mon-espace/annuler')
  async annulerRv(
    @Body() body: Record<string, string>,
    @Req() req: RequeteAuthentifiee,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const patient = await patientConnecte(this.application, req.user);
    const rv = await this.application.getRvById(Number(body.idRv) || 0);
     // an appointment that does not exist, and one for a AUTRE patient, receive
     // the same response: we do not disclose information about other people’s appointments
    if (rv === null || rv.idClient !== patient.id) {
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: 'ERRORS.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND' });
    } else {
      await this.application.supprimerRv(rv);
      flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: 'AGENDA.CANCELLED' });
    }
    res.redirect('/mon-espace');
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // GET /my-account
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Get('mon-compte')
  async formulaireCompte(@Req() req: RequeteAuthentifiee, @Res() res: Response): Promise<void> {
    const patient = await patientConnecte(this.application, req.user);
    this.afficher(res, {
      titre: patient.titre,
      prenom: patient.prenom,
      nom: patient.nom,
      login: patient.user.login,
      version: patient.version,
    });
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /my-account
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('mon-compte')
  @HttpCode(200) // if the form is redisplayed (see auth.controller.ts)
  async modifierCompte(
    @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>,
    @Req() req: RequeteAuthentifiee,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const patient = await patientConnecte(this.application, req.user);
    const { dto, erreurs } = await validerFormulaire(FormulaireMonCompteDto, body);
    const valeurs: ValeursMonCompte = {
      titre: dto.titre ?? patient.titre,
      prenom: typeof dto.prenom === 'string' ? dto.prenom : '',
      nom: typeof dto.nom === 'string' ? dto.nom : '',
      login: dto.login ?? '',
      version: dto.version ?? null,
    };

    const toutesErreurs: ErreursFormulaire = { ...(erreurs ?? {}) };
    if (!toutesErreurs.password && dto.password !== undefined && dto.password !== dto.confirmation) {
      toutesErreurs.confirmation = 'ERRORS.PASSWORDS_DIFFER';
    }
    if (Object.keys(toutesErreurs).length > 0) {
      return this.afficher(res, valeurs, toutesErreurs);
    }

     // the current password
    const erreurMotDePasse = await this.verifierMotDePasseActuel(req, patient, dto.motDePasseActuel);
    if (erreurMotDePasse !== null) {
      return this.afficher(
        res,
        valeurs,
        erreurMotDePasse.cle === 'ERRORS.WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD' ? { motDePasseActuel: erreurMotDePasse.cle } : {},
        erreurMotDePasse.cle,
        [],
        erreurMotDePasse.params,
      );
    }

    try {
      const client = await this.application.modifierClient(patient.id, {
        titre: dto.titre,
        nom: dto.nom,
        prenom: dto.prenom,
        login: dto.login,
        password: dto.password, // undefined = unchanged
        version: dto.version,
      });
       // the login and display name are DANS the token: one is issued
       // new; otherwise, the navigation bar would retain the old name
      res.cookie(COOKIE_JWT, this.authService.creerJeton(client.user), optionsCookieJwt());
      flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: 'MON_COMPTE.UPDATED' });
      res.redirect('/mon-espace');
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof MetierException)) {
        throw e;
      }
      this.afficher(res, valeurs, {}, e.cle, CHAMPS_ERREURS_METIER[e.cle] ?? []);
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   // POST /my-account/delete    field: motDePasseSuppression
   // The account, the client, and TOUS their appointments are all deleted,
   // and then the patient is logged out.
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  @Post('mon-compte/supprimer')
  async supprimerCompte(
    @Body() body: Record<string, string>,
    @Req() req: RequeteAuthentifiee,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const patient = await patientConnecte(this.application, req.user);
    const erreurMotDePasse = await this.verifierMotDePasseActuel(req, patient, body.motDePasseSuppression);
    if (erreurMotDePasse !== null) {
      flash(res, { type: 'danger', cle: erreurMotDePasse.cle, params: erreurMotDePasse.params });
      return res.redirect('/mon-compte');
    }
    await this.application.supprimerClient(patient.id);
    res.clearCookie(COOKIE_JWT, { path: '/' });
    flash(res, { type: 'success', cle: 'MON_COMPTE.DELETED' });
    res.redirect('/login');
  }

   // ----------------------------------------------------------------- private methods

   // null if the current password is correct; otherwise, the message key
  private async verifierMotDePasseActuel(
    req: Request,
    patient: Client,
    motDePasse: unknown,
  ): Promise<{ cle: string; params?: Record<string, string> } | null> {
    const ip = req.ip ?? 'inconnue';
    const login = patient.user.login;
    const minutes = this.limiteur.minutesBlocageLogin(ip, login);
    if (minutes > 0) {
      return { cle: 'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS', params: { minutes: String(minutes) } };
    }
    const ok =
      typeof motDePasse === 'string' &&
      motDePasse !== '' &&
      (await this.authService.validerUtilisateur(login, motDePasse)) !== null;
    if (!ok) {
      this.limiteur.echecLogin(ip, login);
      return { cle: 'ERRORS.WRONG_CURRENT_PASSWORD' };
    }
    return null;
  }

  private afficher(
    res: Response,
    valeurs: ValeursMonCompte,
    erreurs: ErreursFormulaire = {},
    erreur: string | null = null,
    autresChamps: string[] = [],
    erreurParams?: Record<string, string>,
  ): void {
    res.render('patient/compte', {
      titrePage: 'MON_COMPTE.TITLE',
      valeurs,
      titres: optionsTitres(valeurs.titre),
      erreurs,
      champsInvalides: champsInvalides(erreurs, autresChamps),
      erreur: erreur ?? (Object.keys(erreurs).length > 0 ? 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM' : null),
      erreurParams,
      motDePasseMin: MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN,
    });
  }
}

Let’s comment on this code:

  • lines 59–60: reserved for patients;
  • lines 14–17: the golden rule of this controller: the patient in question is always the one associated with the token, never an identifier sent by the browser;
  • lines 74–91: the “My Account” page. [@Res({ passthrough: true })] provides access to the response (to read the language in [res.locals] and format the date) without giving up [@Render] (see Example 05);
  • lines 96–101: canceling an appointment. A nonexistent appointment and another patient’s appointment receive the same response: no information about other patients’ appointments is disclosed;
  • lines 118–128: the account form, pre-filled;
  • lines 133–139: the update: validation, verification of the current password, then the business logic layer. The token contains the login and the display name: after an update, a new token is issued (line 182); otherwise, the navigation bar would retain the old name;
  • Lines 198–203: Delete the account, the record, and all appointments (using the same business layer method as for ADMIN), then log out;
  • lines 219–223: The current password is required for any changes: someone who finds a session that has been left open would be unable to change the password or delete the account. Errors count as login failures;
  • lines 241–248: the form.

docs.title: 11.15. The Views
docs.text: The views have almost no decisions to make: their template has been prepared by the controllers. Each view begins with a comment [Handlebars] [{{!-- ... --}}] that describes its role; these comments do not appear in the pages sent to the browser.

docs.title: 11.15.1.1. views/layout.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/layout.hbs
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Le gabarit COMMUN à toutes les pages. hbs l'utilise automatiquement
  (fichier nommé "layout.hbs" à la racine du dossier des vues) : la page
  demandée par le contrôleur (agenda.hbs, login.hbs...) est insérée à
  l'emplacement {{{body}}}.

  Triple accolades {{{ }}} : le contenu est inséré TEL QUEL, sans
  échappement - indispensable ici, puisque [body] est du HTML déjà fabriqué.
  Partout ailleurs on utilise {{ }}, qui échappe les caractères < > & " '
  (protection contre l'injection de HTML via un nom saisi, par exemple).

  Messages : un succès s'affiche en HAUT de la page ({{> flash}}), une
  erreur en BAS, sur fond rose léger ({{> erreurs}}).

  Équivalent de src/index.html + app.html du client Angular.
  ==========================================================================
--}}
<!doctype html>
<html lang="{{lang}}">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>{{t titrePage}} - {{t 'APP.TITLE'}}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container py-4">
    {{> navbar}}
    {{> flash}}
    {{{body}}}
    {{> erreurs}}
  </div>
  {{!-- la fenêtre "Êtes-vous sûr ?", cachée tant qu'on n'en a pas besoin --}}
  {{> confirmation}}
  <script src="/js/app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
  • line 22: the page’s language (see Example 22);
  • line 26: the title, translated: the key [titrePage] is provided by each action;
  • lines 32–35: the navigation bar, the success message, the page, and the error area;
  • lines 38–39: the confirmation window and its script (see Example 21).

docs.title: 11.15.1.2. views/partials/navbar.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  views/partials/navbar.hbs - la barre de navigation (inséré par {{> navbar}}).

  Même contenu que celle du client Angular (titre, FR/EN, rôle, nom,
  déconnexion), plus un menu dont les entrées dépendent du rôle :
  "Médecins" et "Clients" n'apparaissent que pour l'ADMIN. Ce n'est qu'un
  confort d'affichage : la vraie protection, ce sont les gardes des
  contrôleurs (un USER qui tape /medecins à la main obtient une page 403).
  Un patient (USER) a en plus son menu "Mon espace".
--}}
<nav class="navbar navbar-expand-sm navbar-dark bg-primary rounded mb-4 px-3">
  <span class="navbar-brand mb-0">{{t 'APP.TITLE'}}</span>

  {{#if user}}
    <ul class="navbar-nav me-auto">
      {{#if utilisateur.estPatient}}
        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link {{actif chemin '/mon-'}}" href="/mon-espace">{{t 'APP.MENU_MY_SPACE'}}</a></li>
      {{/if}}
      <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link {{actif chemin '/agenda'}}" href="/agenda">{{t 'APP.MENU_AGENDA'}}</a></li>
      {{#if utilisateur.estAdmin}}
        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link {{actif chemin '/medecins'}}" href="/medecins">{{t 'APP.MENU_DOCTORS'}}</a></li>
        <li class="nav-item"><a class="nav-link {{actif chemin '/clients'}}" href="/clients">{{t 'APP.MENU_PATIENTS'}}</a></li>
      {{/if}}
    </ul>
  {{else}}
    <div class="me-auto"></div>
  {{/if}}

  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
    {{!-- FR / EN : de simples liens (GET /langue/fr), la langue active en surbrillance --}}
    <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group" aria-label="FR / EN">
      <a class="btn {{#if (eq lang 'fr')}}btn-light{{else}}btn-outline-light{{/if}}" href="/langue/fr">FR</a>
      <a class="btn {{#if (eq lang 'en')}}btn-light{{else}}btn-outline-light{{/if}}" href="/langue/en">EN</a>
    </div>

    {{#if user}}
      <span class="badge text-bg-light text-primary">{{utilisateur.role}}</span>
      <span class="text-white">{{utilisateur.nom}}</span>
      {{!-- la déconnexion est un POST : un formulaire réduit à son bouton --}}
      <form method="post" action="/logout" class="m-0">
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-light">{{t 'APP.LOGOUT'}}</button>
      </form>
    {{/if}}
  </div>
</nav>
  • lines 14–25: the menus depend on the role: “My Account” for a patient, “Doctors” and “Clients” for the ADMIN. This is merely for convenience; security is ensured by the controller guards;
  • lines 31–34: the links FR / EN;
  • lines 36–43: the role, name, and logout button in a POST form.

docs.title: 11.15.1.3. views/partials/flash.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  views/partials/flash.hbs - le message de SUCCÈS déposé par l'action
  précédente (rendez-vous enregistré, médecin ajouté...), affiché une seule
  fois, en haut de la page (cf. src/web/contexte-vue.ts).
  Un message flash d'ERREUR, lui, est affiché en bas de la page, par
  views/partials/erreurs.hbs.
--}}
{{#if (eq flash.type 'success')}}
  <div class="alert alert-success" role="status">
    {{t flash.cle nom=flash.params.nom login=flash.params.login minutes=flash.params.minutes}}
  </div>
{{/if}}

line 10: the message is a key; its possible parameters ([nom], [login], [minutes]) are passed to the helper [t].

docs.title: 11.15.1.4. views/partials/erreurs.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/partials/erreurs.hbs - la zone d'erreur, en BAS de chaque page, sur
  fond rose léger (classe .zone-erreur, cf. public/css/styles.css).

  Elle regroupe les deux sources d'erreur possibles :
    - [erreur] : l'erreur de la page affichée (formulaire refusé, login ou
      prénom + nom déjà utilisés, date invalide, mot de passe incorrect...) ;
    - un message flash d'erreur, déposé par l'action précédente avant une
      redirection (créneau déjà réservé, suppression refusée...).

  role="alert" : un lecteur d'écran annonce le message dès l'affichage de
  la page, même s'il se trouve en bas.
  ==========================================================================
--}}
{{#if (or error (eq flash.type 'danger'))}}
  <div class="zone-erreur" role="alert">
    {{#if error}}
      <div>{{t erreur minutes=erreurParams.minutes}}</div>
    {{/if}}
    {{#if (eq flash.type 'danger')}}
      <div>{{t flash.cle nom=flash.params.nom login=flash.params.login minutes=flash.params.minutes}}</div>
    {{/if}}
  </div>
{{/if}}

Line 16: The area is displayed if there is a page error or a flash error message: the helper [ou] combines both conditions, with [eq] used as a sub-expression.

docs.title: 11.15.1.5. views/partials/confirmation.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/partials/confirmation.hbs - la fenêtre modale "Êtes-vous sûr ?".

  Elle remplace la boîte window.confirm() du navigateur, qu'on ne peut ni
  mettre en forme, ni traduire (ses boutons restent dans la langue du
  navigateur, pas dans celle de la page).

  Une SEULE fenêtre pour toute la page, cachée (d-none) au départ. Ses
  libellés sont traduits ici, par le serveur, comme le reste de la page ;
  le petit script public/js/app.js se contente de l'afficher, d'y placer
  le message propre au formulaire (attribut data-confirmation), et d'envoyer
  le formulaire si l'utilisateur confirme.

  Mêmes classes Bootstrap que la fenêtre de réservation (partials/reservation.hbs).
  ==========================================================================
--}}
<div id="modale-confirmation" class="d-none">
  <div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
  <div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true"
       aria-labelledby="modale-confirmation-titre" aria-describedby="modale-confirmation-message">
    <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
      <div class="modal-content">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <h5 class="modal-title" id="modale-confirmation-titre">{{t 'CONFIRMATION.TITLE'}}</h5>
          <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-action="non" aria-label="{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA'}}"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body">
          <p class="mb-0" id="modale-confirmation-message"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-footer">
          {{!-- "Non, revenir" plutôt qu'"Annuler" : la question est parfois
               « Annuler ce rendez-vous ? », et un bouton "Annuler" y serait ambigu --}}
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-action="non">{{t 'CONFIRMATION.NO'}}</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" data-action="oui">{{t 'CONFIRMATION.YES'}}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

The window from Example 21, with translated labels and accessibility attributes: [role="alertdialog"], and [aria-labelledby] / [aria-describedby], which specify the title and message read by a screen reader.

docs.title: 11.15.1.6. views/partials/captcha.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/partials/captcha.hbs - le captcha de la page d'authentification
  (cf. src/auth/captcha.service.ts). Il protège à la fois la connexion et
  l'accès à la création de compte (bouton "Créer un compte client").

  {{{captcha.svg}}} : triple accolades, l'image SVG est insérée TELLE QUELLE
  dans la page. C'est sans danger ici parce que ce SVG est fabriqué par le
  serveur lui-même (bibliothèque svg-captcha) et ne contient rien qui vienne
  de l'utilisateur - on ne ferait JAMAIS cela avec une saisie.

  Le champ caché captchaId dit au serveur QUEL captcha vérifier ; la bonne
  réponse, elle, n'est jamais envoyée au navigateur.
  "Autre image" recharge simplement la page (chemin = l'URL courante).
  ==========================================================================
--}}
<div class="mb-3">
  <label class="form-label" for="captcha">{{t 'CAPTCHA.LABEL'}}</label>
  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
    <div class="captcha-image" role="img" aria-label="{{t 'CAPTCHA.IMAGE_ALT'}}">{{{captcha.svg}}}</div>
    <a class="small" href="{{chemin}}">{{t 'CAPTCHA.NEW_IMAGE'}}</a>
  </div>
  <input type="hidden" name="captchaId" value="{{captcha.id}}">
  <input id="captcha" name="captcha" type="text" maxlength="10" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" required
         class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.captcha}}is-invalid{{/if}}">
  {{#if erreurs.captcha}}
    <div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.captcha}}</div>
  {{else}}
    <div class="form-text">{{t 'CAPTCHA.HELP'}}</div>
  {{/if}}
</div>
  • line 20: the image SVG, inserted as-is (triple curly braces): it is generated by the server, with no user input;
  • line 21: “Another image” simply reloads the page;
  • line 23: the CAPTCHA ID, in a hidden field.

docs.title: 11.15.1.7. views/partials/champsPersonne.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  views/partials/champsPersonne.hbs - les champs d'identité (titre, prénom,
  nom), communs à trois formulaires : médecin/client de l'ADMIN,
  "Créer un compte client" et "Gérer mon compte".
  Le partiel utilise le modèle de la page qui l'insère : valeurs, titres,
  erreurs (message sous le champ) et champsInvalides (encadré rouge).
--}}
<div class="mb-3">
  <label class="form-label" for="titre">{{t 'PERSONNES.TITLE_LABEL'}}</label>
  <select id="titre" name="titre" class="form-select {{#if champsInvalides.titre}}is-invalid{{/if}}">
    {{#each titles}}
      <option value="{{valeur}}" {{#if selected}}selected{{/if}}>{{value}}</option>
    {{/each}}
  </select>
  {{#if erreurs.titre}}<div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.titre}}</div>{{/if}}
</div>

<div class="row g-3 mb-3">
  <div class="col-sm-6">
    <label class="form-label" for="prenom">{{t 'PERSONNES.FIRSTNAME_LABEL'}}</label>
    <input id="prenom" name="prenom" type="text" maxlength="20" required
           class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.prenom}}is-invalid{{/if}}" value="{{valeurs.prenom}}">
    {{#if erreurs.prenom}}<div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.prenom}}</div>{{/if}}
  </div>
  <div class="col-sm-6">
    <label class="form-label" for="nom">{{t 'PERSONNES.LASTNAME_LABEL'}}</label>
    <input id="nom" name="nom" type="text" maxlength="20" required
           class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.nom}}is-invalid{{/if}}" value="{{valeurs.nom}}">
    {{#if erreurs.nom}}<div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.nom}}</div>{{/if}}
  </div>
</div>

The identity fields, common to three forms (see Example 19). A partial inserted without parameters uses the template of the page that inserts it: [valeurs], [titres], [erreurs], [champsInvalides].

docs.title: 11.15.1.8. views/partials/reservation.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/partials/reservation.hbs - la fenêtre de réservation.

  Même technique que le client Angular (booking-dialog) : les VRAIES classes
  Bootstrap d'une fenêtre modale (.modal, .modal-backdrop...), rendues
  visibles "en dur" (show d-block) plutôt que par le JavaScript de
  Bootstrap. La différence : c'est le SERVEUR qui décide de l'afficher
  (paramètre &reserver=... de l'URL), et la fermer revient à suivre un lien
  vers la même page sans ce paramètre.
  ==========================================================================
--}}
<div class="modal-backdrop fade show"></div>
<div class="modal fade show d-block" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="titre-reservation">
  <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
    <form method="post" action="/agenda/reserver" class="modal-content">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h5 class="modal-title" id="titre-reservation">{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE'}}</h5>
        <a class="btn-close" href="{{urlRetour}}" aria-label="{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CLOSE_ARIA'}}"></a>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-body">
        <p>{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT' horaire=reservation.horaire}}</p>

        {{!-- ce que le serveur doit savoir en plus du patient choisi --}}
        <input type="hidden" name="idMedecin" value="{{idMedecin}}">
        <input type="hidden" name="jour" value="{{jour}}">
        <input type="hidden" name="idCreneau" value="{{reservation.idCreneau}}">

        {{#if reservation.patient}}
          {{!-- un patient réserve pour lui-même : pas de liste à choisir
               (et le serveur ignore de toute façon un éventuel idClient) --}}
          <p class="mb-0">{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL'}} : <strong>{{reservation.patient}}</strong></p>
        {{else}}
          <label class="form-label" for="idClient">{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL'}}</label>
          <select id="idClient" name="idClient" class="form-select" required autofocus>
            <option value="">{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT'}}</option>
            {{#each reservation.clients}}
              <option value="{{id}}">{{libelle}}</option>
            {{/each}}
          </select>
        {{/if}}
      </div>

      <div class="modal-footer">
        <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="{{urlRetour}}">{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL'}}</a>
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{t 'BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM'}}</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>
</div>
  • lines 13–14: the [Bootstrap] classes of a modal window, made visible “hard-coded”: the server decides to display it;
  • line 19: closing the window means following a link to the same page, without the [reserver] parameter;
  • lines 26–28: the form’s hidden fields;
  • lines 30–34: a patient sees their name; an administrator selects the patient from a list.

docs.title: 11.15.2.1. views/login.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/login.hbs - le formulaire de connexion.
  Équivalent de features/login/ du client Angular. Un <form> HTML ordinaire :
  le navigateur envoie lui-même login, mot de passe et réponse au captcha en
  POST /login, sans JavaScript. En cas d'échec, le serveur renvoie CETTE
  page, avec le login déjà saisi, un NOUVEAU captcha et [erreur], affichée
  en bas de page par le gabarit.
  ==========================================================================
--}}
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{t 'LOGIN.TITLE'}}</h5>

      <form method="post" action="/login">
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="login">{{t 'LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL'}}</label>
          <input id="login" name="login" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="username"
                 value="{{login}}" required {{#unless login}}autofocus{{/unless}}>
        </div>
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="password">{{t 'LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL'}}</label>
          <input id="password" name="password" type="password" class="form-control"
                 autocomplete="current-password" required {{#if logged in}}autofocus{{/if}}>
        </div>

        {{> captcha}}

        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{t 'LOGIN.SUBMIT'}}</button>

        {{!-- pas encore de compte : un patient peut en créer un lui-même.
             Ce n'est PAS un simple lien : c'est un second bouton d'envoi de
             CE formulaire, qui part vers une autre adresse (formaction). Le
             serveur y vérifie le captcha ci-dessus avant d'ouvrir la page de
             création de compte (cf. InscriptionController).
             formnovalidate : le navigateur n'exige pas login et mot de passe
             (inutiles pour créer un compte) ; c'est le serveur qui vérifie
             le captcha. Entrée dans un champ déclenche toujours le PREMIER
             bouton du formulaire, "Se connecter". --}}
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3"
                formaction="/inscription/acces" formnovalidate>{{t 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT'}}</button>
        <div class="form-text text-center">{{t 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP'}}</div>
      </form>

      <div class="text-muted small mt-3">
        {{t 'LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS'}}
        <ul class="mb-0 mt-1">
          <li><code>admin</code> - {{t 'LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN'}}</li>
          <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - {{t 'LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR'}}</li>
          <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - {{t 'LOGIN.DEMO_USER'}}</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  • line 20: the cursor is placed in the login field, or in the password field if the login is already known;
  • line 28: the CAPTCHA;
  • lines 41–42: the second button submits the same form to [/inscription/acces] ([formaction]). [formnovalidate]: the browser does not require a username and password, as they are not needed to create an account.

docs.title: 11.15.2.2. views/agenda.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/agenda.hbs - la page principale (cf. AgendaController).
  Trois blocs, comme les trois composants du client Angular :
    1. le choix du médecin et du jour   (<app-doctor-day-picker>)
    2. l'agenda                         (<app-agenda>)
    3. la fenêtre de réservation        (<app-booking-dialog>)
  ==========================================================================
--}}

{{!-- une éventuelle erreur (date invalide, médecin inconnu) est affichée
     en bas de la page par le gabarit (cf. views/partials/erreurs.hbs) --}}

{{!-- 1. choix du médecin et du jour : un formulaire GET, qui recharge
     simplement cette page avec ?idMedecin=...&jour=... dans l'URL --}}
<form method="get" action="/agenda" class="card p-3 mb-3">
  <div class="row g-2 align-items-end">
    <div class="col-sm-5">
      <label class="form-label" for="idMedecin">{{t 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL'}}</label>
      <select id="idMedecin" name="idMedecin" class="form-select" required>
        <option value="">{{t 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR'}}</option>
        {{#each doctors}}
          <option value="{{id}}" {{#if selected}}selected{{/if}}>{{label}}</option>
        {{/each}}
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="col-sm-4">
      <label class="form-label" for="jour">{{t 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL'}}</label>
      <input id="jour" name="jour" type="date" class="form-control" value="{{jour}}" required>
    </div>
    <div class="col-sm-3">
      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100">{{t 'DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_AGENDA'}}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</form>

{{!-- patient qui a déjà un rendez-vous à venir : pourquoi il n'y a pas de bouton "Réserver" --}}
{{#if info}}
  <div class="alert alert-info">
    {{t info}} <a href="/mon-espace" class="alert-link">{{t 'APP.MENU_MY_SPACE'}}</a>
  </div>
{{/if}}

{{!-- 2. l'agenda --}}
{{#if calendar}}
  <div class="card p-3">
    <h5>{{t 'AGENDA.TITLE_PREFIX'}} {{agenda.jour}} - {{agenda.medecin}}</h5>

    {{#if agenda.lignes.length}}
      <table class="table table-hover align-middle">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>{{t 'AGENDA.COLUMN_SLOT'}}</th>
            <th>{{t 'AGENDA.COLUMN_STATUS'}}</th>
            <th></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {{#each agenda.lignes}}
            <tr {{#if bookable}}class="available-slot"{{/if}}>
              <td>{{horaire}}</td>
              <td>
                {{!-- [patient] n'est renseigné que si l'utilisateur a le droit
                     de voir ce nom (ADMIN, DOCTOR, ou le patient pour SON
                     rendez-vous) - sinon, simplement « Réservé » --}}
                {{#if available}}
                  <span class="badge text-bg-success">{{t 'AGENDA.FREE'}}</span>
                {{else if patient}}
                  <span class="badge {{#if moi}}text-bg-primary{{else}}text-bg-secondary{{/if}}">{{patient}}</span>
                {{else}}
                  <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">{{t 'AGENDA.BOOKED_BY_OTHER'}}</span>
                {{/if}}
              </td>
              <td>
                {{!-- les boutons affichés ont été décidés par le contrôleur
                     (reservable, idRv) selon le rôle de l'utilisateur --}}
                {{#if bookable}}
                  {{!-- "Réserver" est un simple lien : il rouvre cette page
                       avec la fenêtre de réservation de ce créneau --}}
                  <a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" href="{{urlReserver}}">{{t 'AGENDA.BOOK'}}</a>
                {{/if}}
                {{#if idRv}}
                  {{!-- "Annuler" MODIFIE des données : c'est donc un POST.
                       @root : le modèle de la PAGE (à l'intérieur d'un {{#each}},
                       les noms simples désignent les champs de la ligne courante) --}}
                  <form method="post" action="/agenda/annuler" class="m-0"
                        data-confirmation="{{t 'AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'}}">
                    <input type="hidden" name="idRv" value="{{idRv}}">
                    <input type="hidden" name="idMedecin" value="{{@root.idMedecin}}">
                    <input type="hidden" name="jour" value="{{@root.jour}}">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger">{{t 'AGENDA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT'}}</button>
                  </form>
                {{/if}}
              </td>
            </tr>
          {{/each}}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    {{else}}
      <p class="text-muted mb-0">{{t 'AGENDA.NO_SLOTS'}}</p>
    {{/if}}
  </div>
{{else}}
  <p class="text-muted">{{t 'AGENDA.EMPTY_STATE'}}</p>
{{/if}}

{{!-- 3. la fenêtre de réservation, seulement si l'URL contient &reserver=... --}}
{{#if reservation}}

docs.title: 11.15.2.4. views/people/formulaire.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/personnes/formulaire.hbs - création OU modification d'un médecin
  ou d'un client (ADMIN). [creation] distingue les deux cas.

  Quand la saisie est refusée (champ vide, login déjà pris...), le
  contrôleur renvoie CETTE vue avec :
    - les valeurs déjà saisies (valeurs.xxx) ;
    - les champs fautifs encadrés en rouge (champsInvalides.xxx, classe
      Bootstrap "is-invalid") ;
    - sous un champ refusé par la validation, son message (erreurs.xxx) ;
    - le message d'erreur de la page (erreur), affiché EN BAS de la page
      par le gabarit (cf. views/partials/erreurs.hbs).
  ==========================================================================
--}}
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{t titrePage}}</h5>

      {{!-- novalidate : on laisse le SERVEUR valider (c'est lui qui fait
           foi) ; les contrôles du navigateur (required...) ne sont qu'un
           confort, qu'un utilisateur peut toujours contourner --}}
      <form method="post" action="{{action}}" novalidate>
        {{#unless created}}
          <input type="hidden" name="version" value="{{valeurs.version}}">
        {{/unless}}

        {{!-- titre, prénom, nom : partiel commun à trois formulaires --}}
        {{> champsPersonne}}

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{t 'PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'}}</h6>

        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="login">{{t 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL'}}</label>
          <input id="login" name="login" type="text" maxlength="30" autocomplete="off"
                 class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.login}}is-invalid{{/if}}" value="{{valeurs.login}}">
          {{#if erreurs.login}}
            <div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.login}}</div>
          {{else}}
            <div class="form-text">{{#if creation}}{{t 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE'}}{{else}}{{t 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT'}}{{/if}}</div>
          {{/if}}
        </div>

        <div class="mb-4">
          <label class="form-label" for="password">{{t 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL'}}</label>
          {{!-- jamais pré-rempli : le mot de passe ne repart jamais vers le navigateur --}}
          <input id="password" name="password" type="password" maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password"
                 class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.password}}is-invalid{{/if}}">
          {{#if erreurs.password}}
            <div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.password}}</div>
          {{else}}
            <div class="form-text">{{#if creation}}{{t 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE'}}{{else}}{{t 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT'}}{{/if}}</div>
          {{/if}}
        </div>

        <div class="d-flex gap-2">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{t 'PERSONNES.SAVE'}}</button>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="{{urlListe}}">{{t 'PERSONNES.BACK'}}</a>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  • Line 24: The shipping address ([action]) is provided by the controller. [novalidate]: The server validates this;
  • Lines 25–27: the version number, for a modification;
  • line 30: the identity fields;
  • lines 35–42: the login, with a help text or error message;
  • lines 46–54: the password, which is never pre-filled.

docs.title: 11.15.2.5. views/compte/inscription.hbs
docs.text:
{{!--
  ==========================================================================
  views/compte/inscription.hbs - "Créer un compte client" (page publique,
  cf. InscriptionController). Mêmes champs d'identité que le formulaire de
  l'ADMIN (partiel champsPersonne), mais le login et le mot de passe sont
  obligatoires, avec confirmation.
  Pas de captcha ICI : on n'arrive sur cette page qu'après avoir recopié
  celui de la page d'authentification (bouton "Créer un compte client").
  "Retour à la connexion" ramène à la page d'authentification.
  ==========================================================================
--}}
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-1">{{t 'INSCRIPTION.TITLE'}}</h5>
      <p class="text-muted small mb-3">{{t 'INSCRIPTION.INTRO'}}</p>

      <form method="post" action="/inscription" novalidate>
        {{> champsPersonne}}

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{t 'PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'}}</h6>

        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="login">{{t 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL'}}</label>
          <input id="login" name="login" type="text" maxlength="30" autocomplete="username" required
                 class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.login}}is-invalid{{/if}}" value="{{valeurs.login}}">
          {{#if erreurs.login}}
            <div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.login}}</div>
          {{else}}
            <div class="form-text">{{t 'INSCRIPTION.LOGIN_HELP'}}</div>
          {{/if}}
        </div>

        <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
          <div class="col-sm-6">
            <label class="form-label" for="password">{{t 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL'}}</label>
            <input id="password" name="password" type="password" maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" required
                   class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.password}}is-invalid{{/if}}">
            {{#if erreurs.password}}
              <div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.password min=motDePasseMin}}</div>
            {{else}}
              <div class="form-text">{{t 'INSCRIPTION.PASSWORD_HELP' min=motDePasseMin}}</div>
            {{/if}}
          </div>
          <div class="col-sm-6">
            <label class="form-label" for="confirmation">{{t 'COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL'}}</label>
            <input id="confirmation" name="confirmation" type="password" maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password" required
                   class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.confirmation}}is-invalid{{/if}}">
            {{#if erreurs.confirmation}}<div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.confirmation}}</div>{{/if}}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="d-flex gap-2">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">{{t 'INSCRIPTION.SUBMIT'}}</button>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="/login">{{t 'INSCRIPTION.BACK_TO_LOGIN'}}</a>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

Creating an account. Line 42: The help text has a parameter—the minimum password length—provided by the controller.

{{!--

  views/patient/compte.hbs - "Gérer mon compte" (rôle USER).

    1. la modification (identité, login, nouveau mot de passe facultatif) ;

                   class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.password}}is-invalid{{/if}}">
            {{#if erreurs.password}}
              <div class="invalid-feedback">{{t erreurs.password min=motDePasseMin}}</div>
            {{else}}
              <div class="form-text">{{t 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT'}}</div>
            {{/if}}
          </div>
          <div class="col-sm-6">
            <label class="form-label" for="confirmation">{{t 'COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL'}}</label>
            <input id="confirmation" name="confirmation" type="password" maxlength="72" autocomplete="new-password"
                   class="form-control {{#if champsInvalides.confirmation}}is-invalid{{/if}}">

          </div>

      </form>
    </div>

  </div>

docs.title: 11.17.2. public/js/app.js
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// public/js/app.js - the application's SEUL JavaScript.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The entire application works without JavaScript. This script adds a
// convenience feature: before submitting a form that includes the
// data-confirmation="...", a modal window asks "Are you sure?"
// (the window itself is located in the page: views/partials/confirmation.hbs).
// If JavaScript is disabled, the form simply submits without
// confirmation—nothing breaks (the principle of “progressive enhancement”).
//
// Why not window.confirm()? Its input field doesn’t format properly, and its
// buttons remain in the browser’s language, not the page’s.
// =========================================================================

(() => {
  const modale = document.getElementById('modale-confirmation');
  if (!modale) {
    return;
  }
  const message = document.getElementById('modale-confirmation-message');
  const boutonNon = modale.querySelector('.modal-footer [data-action="non"]');

  let formulaireEnAttente = null; // the form to submit if you confirm
  let focusPrecedent = null; // the element to focus on when closing

  function ouvrir(formulaire) {
    formulaireEnAttente = formulaire;
    focusPrecedent = document.activeElement;
     // textContent (not innerHTML): the message is displayed as TEXTE,
     // never interpreted as HTML
    message.textContent = formulaire.dataset.confirmation;
    modale.classList.remove('d-none');
     // the focus moves to "No": accidentally pressing Enter does not delete anything
    boutonNon.focus();
  }

  function fermer() {
    modale.classList.add('d-none');
    formulaireEnAttente = null;
    if (focusPrecedent) {
      focusPrecedent.focus();
    }
  }

   // 1. We intercept the submission of forms requiring confirmation
  document.querySelectorAll('form[data-confirmation]').forEach((formulaire) => {
    formulaire.addEventListener('submit', (evenement) => {
      evenement.preventDefault();
      ouvrir(formulaire);
    });
  });

   // 2. The window’s buttons (Yes / No / close button)
  modale.addEventListener('click', (evenement) => {
    const action = evenement.target.closest('[data-action]')?.dataset.action;
    if (action === 'oui') {
      const formulaire = formulaireEnAttente;
      fermer();
       // formulaire.submit() submits the form SANS to trigger again
       // The 'submit' event: no new confirmation request
      formulaire.submit();
    } else if (action === 'non') {
      fermer();
    } else if (evenement.target.classList.contains('modal')) {
      fermer(); // Click on the grayed-out background, outside the window
    }
  });

   // 3. Keyboard: Esc closes the window; Tab keeps the focus on the window
   /   / (otherwise, the focus would move to the grayed-out page behind it)
  modale.addEventListener('keydown', (evenement) => {
    if (evenement.key === 'Escape') {
      fermer();
    } else if (evenement.key === 'Tab') {
      const boutons = [...modale.querySelectorAll('button')];
      const premier = boutons[0];
      const dernier = boutons[boutons.length - 1];
      if (evenement.shiftKey && document.activeElement === premier) {
        evenement.preventDefault();
        dernier.focus();
      } else if (!evenement.shiftKey && document.activeElement === dernier) {
        evenement.preventDefault();
        premier.focus();
      }
    }
  });
})();

The completed script for the confirmation window in Example 21:

  • lines 17–19: a page without a confirmation window has nothing to do;
  • line 24: the element that had keyboard focus before the window opened, to which focus is returned when the window closes;
  • lines 26–35: focus is placed on “No, go back”; an accidental press of Enter does not delete anything;
  • lines 37–43: the window is hidden, and focus is restored;
  • Lines 54–67: “Yes,” “No,” the close button, and clicking outside the window. [closest('[data-action]')] finds the element containing the attribute, even if you clicked on an element within it;
  • lines 71–86: The Esc key closes the window; the Tab key cycles the focus within the window, rather than letting it move to the grayed-out page behind it.

docs.title: 12. Conclusion
docs.text:
This document has presented the construction of a MVC web application using the [NestJS] framework: an application whose HTML pages are generated by the server, without a browser-side [JavaScript] framework. It followed the progression of the “Introduction to ASP.NET MVC” course through examples: controllers and routing to views, forms, internationalization, security, and data access, followed by a complete case study.

There are numerous parallels between the two frameworks:

ASP.NET MVC (2013)NestJS (2026)controller, action ([ActionResult])controller [@Controller], action [@Get], [@Post]action template, [[Required]], [[Range]]...Class DTO, decorators of [class-validator][ModelState.IsValid][validate()] and form redispatchviews [Razor] ([.cshtml]), [_Layout.cshtml]views [Handlebars] ([.hbs]), [layout.hbs]partial views, helpers HTMLPartials [{{> nom}}], helpers [hbs.registerHelper][TempData]Flash message in a cookiesessioncookies (token JWT, language): stateless serveraction filters, [[Authorize]]middleware, guards ([@UseGuards], [@Roles]), interceptorsresource files ([.resx])dictionaries JSON, helper [t][Entity Framework][TypeORM]

The case study shows that a classic HTML application, without the essential [JavaScript], remains a simple and robust solution: each page is a URL, the browser’s “Back” button works, and the server controls everything. The minimal use of [JavaScript] (the confirmation window) enhances the user experience without being necessary for the application to function.

To learn more, you can consult the [NestJS] documentation (docs.nestjs.com), and compare this application to its two sister applications, which use the same [NestJS] server in version JSON with a [Angular] or [Flutter] client.

docs.title: 2. Controllers, Actions, Routing
docs.text: This chapter examines the path a request takes, from the browser to the action that processes it, and the response that action returns. Views will not be introduced until Chapter 4: here, actions return text or JSON directly.

docs.title: 2.1. Example 01: The Structure of a NestJS Application
docs.text:
The first example is the smallest possible [NestJS] application. It has three files:

01-structure/
├── src/
│   ├── app.controller.ts
│   ├── app.module.ts
│   └── main.ts
├── nest-cli.json
└── tsconfig.json

docs.title: 2.1.1. The entry point: main.ts
docs.text:
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';

async function bootstrap() {
   //builds the application from its root module
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);
   // starts the HTTP server on port 3000
  await app.listen(3000);
  console.log('Serveur démarré sur http://localhost:3000');
}

bootstrap();

Let’s comment on this code:

  • line 1: [NestFactory] is the “factory” for [NestJS] applications;
  • line 2: the application’s root module, which we’ll cover later;
  • line 4: the startup function is asynchronous ([async]): building the application and starting the server take time, and we wait ([await]) for each step to complete;
  • line 6: builds the application from its root module. [NestJS] then discovers all the application’s controllers and services and creates their instances;
  • line 8: starts the HTTP server on port 3000;
  • line 12: calls the startup function.

docs.title: 2.1.2. The root module: app.module.ts
docs.text:
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AppController } from './app.controller';

@Module({
  controllers: [AppController],
})
export class AppModule {}
  • Line 4: The [@Module] decorator turns the [AppModule] class into a [NestJS] module. A module groups together controllers and services that belong together. A small application has only one module; a large one has several (see Example 06);
  • line 5: the list of controllers in the module;
  • line 7: the class itself is empty—everything is in the decorator.

docs.title: 2.1.3. The controller: app.controller.ts
docs.text:
import { Controller, Get } from '@nestjs/common';

@Controller()
export class AppController {
  @Get()
  accueil(): string {
    return 'Bonjour de la part de NestJS !';
  }
}
  • Line 3: The [@Controller()] decorator turns the class into a controller. Without any arguments, its routes start at the root of the site ([/]);
  • Line 5: The [@Get()] decorator associates the [accueil] method with [GET /] requests. A method decorated in this way is an action;
  • line 7: The value returned by the action is the response sent to the browser.

docs.title: 2.1.4. Execution
docs.text:
In a console opened in the [01-structure] folder, type [npx nest start]:

[Nest] 1885  - 09/23/2026, 4:02:05 PM     LOG [NestFactory] Starting Nest application...
[Nest] 1885  - 09/23/2026, 4:02:05 PM     LOG [InstanceLoader] AppModule dependencies initialized +8ms
[Nest] 1885  - 09/23/2026, 4:02:05 PM     LOG [RoutesResolver] AppController {/}: +3ms
[Nest] 1885  - 09/23/2026, 4:02:05 PM     LOG [RouterExplorer] Mapped {/, GET} route +2ms
[Nest] 1885  - 09/23/2026, 4:02:05 PM     LOG [NestApplication] Nest application successfully started +1ms
Serveur démarré sur http://localhost:3000

[NestJS] displays the routes it found: in this case, only one, [{/, GET}], served by [AppController]. Let’s look up URL and [http://localhost:3000/] using a browser:

then with [curl]. The [-i] option also displays the HTTP headers from the response (we’ll only show a few of them here):

curl -i http://localhost:3000/

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 30

Bonjour de la part de NestJS !

A string returned by an action is sent with the header [Content-Type: text/html]: the browser interprets it as HTML.

docs.title: 2.2. Example 02: Routing
docs.text:
Routing associates a URL and a method HTTP (GET, POST...) with an action. Example 02 has two controllers:

02-routage/
├── src/
│   ├── app.controller.ts
│   ├── app.module.ts
│   ├── main.ts
│   └── premier.controller.ts
├── nest-cli.json
└── tsconfig.json

The file [src/app.module.ts]:

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AppController } from './app.controller';
import { PremierController } from './premier.controller';

@Module({
  controllers: [AppController, PremierController],
})
export class AppModule {}

Line 6: The module declares its two controllers.

The file [src/app.controller.ts]:

import { Controller, Get } from '@nestjs/common';

@Controller()
export class AppController {
   // GET /
  @Get()
  accueil(): string {
    return `<h2>Exemple 02 - le routage</h2>
      <ul>
        <li><a href="/premier">/premier</a></li>
        <li><a href="/premier/action01">/premier/action01</a></li>
        <li><a href="/premier/produits/17">/premier/produits/17</a></li>
        <li><a href="/premier/produits/17/avis/3">/premier/produits/17/avis/3</a></li>
        <li><a href="/premier/fichiers/images/logo.png">/premier/fichiers/images/logo.png</a></li>
        <li><a href="/inconnue">/inconnue</a></li>
      </ul>`;
  }
}

The [accueil] action (lines 6–17) returns a HTML page that contains links to the actions of the other controller:

The file [src/premier.controller.ts]:

import { Controller, Get, Param, Post } from '@nestjs/common';

@Controller('premier')
export class PremierController {
   // GET /first
  @Get()
  index(): string {
    return 'Action [index] du contrôleur [premier]';
  }

   // GET /first/action01
  @Get('action01')
  action01(): string {
    return 'Action [action01] du contrôleur [premier], requête GET';
  }

   // POST /first/action01: same path, different method HTTP
  @Post('action01')
  action01Post(): string {
    return 'Action [action01Post] du contrôleur [premier], requête POST';
  }

   // GET /first/products/17: [:id] is a route parameter
  @Get('produits/:id')
  produit(@Param('id') id: string): string {
    return `Produit n° ${id}`;
  }

   // GET /first/products/17/reviews/3: two route parameters
  @Get('produits/:id/avis/:numero')
  avis(@Param() params: { id: string; numero: string }): string {
    return `Avis n° ${params.numero} du produit n° ${params.id}`;
  }

   // GET /first/files/... : [*] accepts any path ending
  @Get('fichiers/*')
  fichier(@Param('0') chemin: string): string {
    return `Fichier demandé : ${chemin}`;
  }
}

Let’s break down this code:

  • line 3: [@Controller('premier')] sets the prefix common to all routes in the controller: its actions handle URL routes that begin with [/premier];
  • lines 6–7: [@Get()] with no arguments: the action [index] handles [GET /premier];
  • lines 12–13: the action [action01] processes [GET /premier/action01]. URL is the concatenation of the controller prefix and the action path;
  • lines 18–19: the same path, but for the POST method: [@Post] replaces [@Get]. There are also [@Put], [@Delete], [@Patch], [@All]... The method name [TypeScript] ([action01Post]) is arbitrary: only the decorators matter for routing;
  • Lines 24–25: [:id] is a route parameter: this segment of URL can take any value. The [@Param('id')] decorator injects its value into the action’s [id] parameter. This value is always a string: for [/premier/produits/17], [id] is ['17'], not the number 17;
  • lines 30–31: two route parameters. [@Param()] without an argument injects an object that contains them all: [{ id: '17', numero: '3' }];
  • lines 36–37: the character [*] accepts any ending of URL, including [/]. The corresponding part is the parameter named [0].

Upon startup, [NestJS] displays all routes:

Serveur démarré sur http://localhost:3000

Here are the responses to a few queries:

curl -i http://localhost:3000/first

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 39

Action [index] du contrôleur [premier]

curl -i http://localhost:3000/first/action01

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 56

Action [action01] du contrôleur [premier], requête GET

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

Produit n° 17

HTTP/1.1 200 OK

To send a POST request, use the [-X POST] option of [curl]:

HTTP/1.1 201 Created

Note the status code 201 Created: this is the code that [NestJS] uses by default to respond to a POST. We’ll see how to change it. Finally, a URL that is not handled by any route produces a 404 error, which [NestJS] maps by default to JSON:

docs.title: 2.3. Example 03: Responses to an Action
docs.text:
What an action returns determines the response HTTP. Example 03 reviews the main cases:

The [src/reponses.controller.ts] file:

import { Controller, Get, Header, HttpCode, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';

@Controller('reponses')
export class ReponsesController {
   // a string: sent as-is, with the type [text/html]
  @Get('html')
  html(): string {
    return '<h1>Action [html]</h1>';
  }

   // the same string, but declared as plain text
  @Get('texte')
  @Header('Content-Type', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8')
  texte(): string {
    return '<h1>Action [texte]</h1>';
  }

   // an object: serialized as JSON, with the type [application/json]
  @Get('json')
  json(): object {
    return { nom: 'Martin', prenom: 'Jean', age: 42 };
  }

   // an array: also serialized as JSON
  @Get('tableau')
  tableau(): string[] {
    return ['Mme', 'Mlle', 'Mr'];
  }

   // a selected status code: 201 (Created) instead of 200 (OK)
  @Get('cree')
  @HttpCode(201)
  cree(): object {
    return { message: 'ressource créée' };
  }

   // no response: code 204 (No Content) means “nothing to display”
  @Get('vide')
  @HttpCode(204)
  vide(): void {}

   // an asynchronous method: NestJS waits for the promise to resolve
  @Get('promesse')
  async promesse(): Promise<object> {
    const debut = Date.now();
    await new Promise((fini) => setTimeout(fini, 500));
    return { attente: `${Date.now() - debut} ms` };
  }

   // an exception: NestJS converts it into an error response
  @Get('erreur')
  erreur(): string {
    throw new NotFoundException('Cette ressource n\'existe pas');
  }
}

Let’s break down this code:

  • lines 6–9: a string is sent as-is, with the header [Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8];
  • lines 12–16: the [@Header] decorator sets a response header. Declared as plain text ([text/plain]), the same string is no longer interpreted by the browser;
  • lines 19–22: an object is serialized as JSON, with the header [Content-Type: application/json];
  • lines 25–28: an array is also serialized as JSON;
  • lines 31–35: [@HttpCode(201)] changes the response status code (default 200 for a GET);
  • lines 38–40: the code 204 (No Content) means “no content”: the action returns nothing;
  • lines 43–48: an action can be asynchronous ([async]): in that case, it returns a promise ([Promise]), and [NestJS] waits for it to resolve before responding. This is the case for all actions that query a database;
  • Lines 51–54: An action can trigger an exception. The exceptions for [NestJS] ([NotFoundException], [BadRequestException], [ForbiddenException]...) each carry a status code HTTP (here 404), which [NestJS] uses for its response.

The responses received:

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/html

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 22

<h1>Action [html]</h1>

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/text

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 23

<h1>Action [texte]</h1>

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 41

{"nom":"Martin","prenom":"Jean","age":42}

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/array

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 19

["Mme","Mlle","Mr"]

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/cree

HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 31

{"message":"ressource créée"}

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/empty

HTTP/1.1 204 No Content

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/promise

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 20

{"attente":"500 ms"}

curl -i http://localhost:3000/responses/error

HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
